critical_code_review_comments: /api/patients/timeline uses string-key (str(ts)) sort. Mixed ISO datetimes vs 'YYYY-MM-DD' date strings sort lexicographically — works because both formats start with year, but if any 'ts' is None/non-iso the ordering will be inconsistent. Consider parsing to datetime before sorting.
Header docstring lists path /api/patients/{phone}/timeline but the actual route is /api/patients/timeline?phone=...; minor doc drift only.

Global search adds extra phone-suffix booking matches but bounds final list with deduped[: max(20, limit*5)] AFTER the dedupe. With default limit=8 the cap is 40 — reasonable but the limit query param's intent is fuzzy.
